sentences.en: How Madagascar’s bats are helping to save the rainforest
sentences.zh: 马达加斯加的蝙蝠怎样帮助保护雨林

sentences.en: There are few places in the world where relations between agriculture and conservation are more strained.
sentences.zh: 世界上鲜有地方像这里一样，农业与自然保护之间的关系如此紧张。

sentences.en: Madagascar’s forests are being converted to agricultural land at a rate of one percent every year.
sentences.zh: 马达加斯加的森林正以每年1%的速度被改作农用地。

sentences.en: Much of this destruction is fuelled by the cultivation of the country’s main staple crop: rice.
sentences.zh: 这种破坏在很大程度上是由种植该国主要粮食作物水稻所驱动的。

sentences.en: And a key reason for this destruction is that insect pests are destroying vast quantities of what is grown by local subsistence farmers, leading them to clear forest to create new paddy fields.
sentences.zh: 森林遭到破坏的一个重要原因是，害虫毁掉当地自给农户种植的大量作物，迫使他们清除森林，开辟新的稻田。

sentences.en: The result is devastating habitat and biodiversity loss on the island, but not all species are suffering.
sentences.zh: 结果是岛上的栖息地和生物多样性遭受了毁灭性的损失。不过，受害的并非所有物种。

sentences.en: In fact, some of the island’s insectivorous bats are currently thriving and this has important implications for farmers and conservationists alike.
sentences.zh: 事实上，岛上一些食虫蝙蝠目前正繁衍兴盛，这对农民和自然保护人士都有重要意义。

sentences.en: Enter University of Cambridge zoologist Ricardo Rocha.
sentences.zh: 这时，剑桥大学动物学家里卡多·罗沙登场了。

sentences.en: He’s passionate about conservation, and bats.
sentences.zh: 他热爱自然保护，也热爱蝙蝠。

sentences.en: More specifically, he’s interested in how bats are responding to human activity and deforestation in particular.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，他想知道蝙蝠如何应对人类活动，尤其是森林砍伐。

sentences.en: Rocha’s new study shows that several species of bats are giving Madagascar’s rice farmers a vital pest control service by feasting on plagues of insects.
sentences.zh: 罗沙的新研究表明，几种蝙蝠大量捕食成群肆虐的昆虫，为马达加斯加的稻农提供了至关重要的虫害控制服务。

sentences.en: And this, he believes, can ease the financial pressure on farmers to turn forest into fields.
sentences.zh: 他认为，这可以减轻农民因经济压力而不得不把森林改为农田的负担。

sentences.en: Bats comprise roughly one-fifth of all mammal species in Madagascar and thirty-six recorded bat species are native to the island, making it one of the most important regions for conservation of this animal group anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 在马达加斯加全部哺乳动物物种中，蝙蝠约占五分之一，岛上有记载的原生蝙蝠共有36种；因此，这里是全球保护这一动物类群最重要的地区之一。

sentences.en: Co-leading an international team of scientists, Rocha found that several species of indigenous bats are taking advantage of habitat modification to hunt insects swarming above the country’s rice fields.
sentences.zh: 罗沙与他人共同领导一个国际科学家团队，发现几种本土蝙蝠利用栖息地的改变，捕食该国稻田上空成群飞舞的昆虫。

sentences.en: They include the Malagasy mouse-eared bat, Major’s long-fingered bat, the Malagasy white-bellied free-tailed bat and Peters’ wrinkle-lipped bat.
sentences.zh: 其中有马达加斯加鼠耳蝠、马氏长指蝠、马达加斯加白腹犬吻蝠和彼氏皱唇蝠。

sentences.en: ‘These winner species are providing a valuable free service to Madagascar as biological pest suppressors,’ says Rocha.
sentences.zh: 罗沙说：“这些在环境变化中获益的物种，正在发挥生物控害作用，为马达加斯加免费提供了一项宝贵的服务。”

sentences.en: ‘We found that six species of bat are preying on rice pests, including the paddy swarming caterpillar and grass webworm.
sentences.zh: “我们发现，有六种蝙蝠以水稻害虫为食，其中包括稻田黏虫和草螟幼虫。

sentences.en: The damage which these insects cause puts the island’s farmers under huge financial pressure and that encourages deforestation.’
sentences.zh: 这些昆虫造成的损失给岛上的农民带来了巨大的经济压力，促使人们砍伐森林。”

sentences.en: The study, now published in the journal Agriculture, Ecosystems and Environment, set out to investigate the feeding activity of insectivorous bats in the farmland bordering the Ranomafana National Park in the southeast of the country.
sentences.zh: 这项研究现已发表于《农业、生态系统与环境》期刊，目的是调查该国东南部拉努马法纳国家公园毗邻农田中食虫蝙蝠的觅食活动。

sentences.en: Rocha and his team used state-of-the-art ultrasonic recorders to record over a thousand bat ‘feeding buzzes’ (echolocation sequences used by bats to target their prey) at 54 sites, in order to identify the favourite feeding spots of the bats.
sentences.zh: 罗沙和团队使用先进的超声波记录仪，在54个地点记录了蝙蝠一千多次“捕食嗡声”——蝙蝠用来锁定猎物的一连串回声定位信号，借此找出蝙蝠最喜欢的觅食地点。

sentences.en: They next used DNA barcoding techniques to analyse droppings collected from bats at the different sites.
sentences.zh: 接下来，他们运用DNA条形码技术，分析从不同地点的蝙蝠身上收集的粪便。

sentences.en: The recordings revealed that bat activity over rice fields was much higher than it was in continuous forest — seven times higher over rice fields which were on flat ground, and sixteen times higher over fields on the sides of hills — leaving no doubt that the animals are preferentially foraging in these man-made ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 录音显示，蝙蝠在稻田上空的活动水平远高于连片的森林：平地稻田上空是连片森林的七倍，山坡稻田上空则是十六倍。由此可以肯定，这些动物更愿意在这些人造生态系统中觅食。

sentences.en: The researchers suggest that the bats favour these fields because lack of water and nutrient run-off make these crops more susceptible to insect pest infestations.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为，蝙蝠之所以偏爱这些农田，是因为缺水和养分随径流流失，使稻作物更容易遭受虫害。

sentences.en: DNA analysis showed that all six species of bat had fed on economically important insect pests.
sentences.zh: DNA分析表明，所有这六种蝙蝠都吃过对农业经济影响显著的害虫。

sentences.en: While the findings indicated that rice farming benefits most from the bats, the scientists also found indications that the bats were consuming pests of other crops, including the black twig borer (which infests coffee plants), the sugarcane cicada, the macadamia nut-borer, and the sober tabby (a pest of citrus fruits).
sentences.zh: 研究结果表明，稻作最能从蝙蝠的活动中获益。科学家也发现，蝙蝠还捕食危害其他作物的害虫，包括侵害咖啡树的黑枝小蠹、甘蔗蝉、澳洲坚果蛀虫，还有一种叫 sober tabby 的蛾，它是柑橘类果树的害虫。

sentences.en: ‘The effectiveness of bats as pest controllers has already been proven in the USA and Catalonia,’ said co-author James Kemp, from the University of Lisbon.
sentences.zh: 来自里斯本大学的合著者詹姆斯·肯普说：“蝙蝠防治害虫的成效在美国和加泰罗尼亚都已得到证实。”

sentences.en: ‘But our study is the first to show this happening in Madagascar, where the stakes for both farmers and conservationists are so high.’
sentences.zh: “但我们的研究首次证明，这种情况也发生在马达加斯加，而对这里的农民和自然保护人士来说，此事都关系重大。”

sentences.en: Local people may have a further reason to be grateful to their bats.
sentences.zh: 当地人也许还有一个理由值得感谢他们身边的蝙蝠。

sentences.en: While the animal is often associated with spreading disease, Rocha and his team found evidence that Malagasy bats feed not just on crop pests but also on mosquitoes — carriers of malaria, Rift Valley fever virus and elephantiasis — as well as blackflies, which spread river blindness.
sentences.zh: 虽然人们常把蝙蝠与疾病传播联系在一起，罗沙和他的团队却发现，马达加斯加的蝙蝠吃的不只是农作物害虫，还有蚊子，而蚊子能传播疟疾、裂谷热病毒以及可引起象皮病的寄生虫。蝙蝠也吃传播河盲症的蚋。

sentences.en: Rocha points out that the relationship is complicated.
sentences.zh: 罗沙指出，人和蝙蝠的关系很复杂。

sentences.en: When food is scarce, bats become a crucial source of protein for local people.
sentences.zh: 食物匮乏时，蝙蝠成了当地人重要的蛋白质来源。

sentences.en: Even the children will hunt them.
sentences.zh: 连孩子都会去猎捕它们。

sentences.en: And as well as roosting in trees, the bats sometimes roost in buildings, but are not welcomed there because they make them unclean.
sentences.zh: 除了栖息在树上，蝙蝠有时也栖息在建筑物里。但它们会把建筑物弄脏，在那里并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: At the same time, however, they are associated with sacred caves and the ancestors, so they can be viewed as beings between worlds, which makes them very significant in the culture of the people.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，人们又把蝙蝠与神圣的洞穴和祖先联系起来，把它们看作往来于两个世界之间的生灵；因此，它们在当地文化中十分重要。

sentences.en: And one potential problem is that while these bats are benefiting from farming, at the same time deforestation is reducing the places where they can roost, which could have long-term effects on their numbers.
sentences.zh: 一个潜在的问题是，这些蝙蝠虽然受益于耕作，同时却因砍伐森林而失去栖息地，这种变化可能对它们的种群数量产生长期影响。

sentences.en: Rocha says, ‘With the right help, we hope that farmers can promote this mutually beneficial relationship by installing bat houses.’
sentences.zh: 罗沙说：“我们希望，只要得到恰当的帮助，农民就能通过安装蝙蝠巢箱来促进这种互利关系。”

sentences.en: Rocha and his colleagues believe that maximising bat populations can help to boost crop yields and promote sustainable livelihoods.
sentences.zh: 罗沙和他的同事认为，尽量增加蝙蝠种群数量，有助于提高作物产量，促进当地生计的可持续发展。

sentences.en: The team is now calling for further research to quantify this contribution.
sentences.zh: 团队现正呼吁开展更多研究，以量化蝙蝠作出的这种贡献。

sentences.en: ‘I’m very optimistic,’ says Rocha.
sentences.zh: “我非常乐观，”罗沙说。

sentences.en: ‘If we give nature a hand, we can speed up the process of regeneration.’
sentences.zh: “如果我们助大自然一臂之力，就能加快自然恢复的进程。”
